title: Potentially dangerous for pets breathing when this is in use!! No thanks
text:
Potentially dangerous for pets breathing when this is in use!! No thanks. First, I have zero clue who Ayesha is or why her name is on this pan. Second, I am not entirely sure this pan is actually made of steel as claimed. It is light weight and doesn't feel like my actual steel roasting pans. Nonetheless, it is a good size and appears to be well made. The handles are tall so you can pull it out of the oven comfortably.

I did make a TexMex casserole in it at 375 degrees the other night. Everything cooked normally and clean up was fine. Let me be clear - I put this in the dishwasher - I won't tolerate any plans that require hand washing only. I don't have time for that nonsense.

I'm very concerned about the safety warning for pets when using this. After reading the paperwork that came with it, I won't ever use this again. If it's potentially dangerous for my dogs to breath around the pan, then it's surely dangerous for the rest of us. I'll be tossing this out.

description: Roast up family favorites and traditional special-occasion recipes with the Ayesha Bakeware 11-inch x 15-inch Nonstick Roaster with Convertible Rack. This high-quality roaster features enhanced nonstick coating for easy, dependable food release recipe after recipe. Constructed from heavy-duty, high-performance steel, the roasting pan boasts excellent resistance to warping and bending and is formed with extended edges with stainless steel handles for easy control and a distinctive, chic design. The roaster also features an adjustable nonstick roasting rack to handle roasts and cuts of all sizes, with a center spire for standing poultry up to cook on end. Both the roaster and rack are dishwasher-safe but hand-washing is recommended for best performance. Oven safe to 450°F so be sure to grab your oven mitts before grabbing those sturdy handles! From roast beef to turkey to lemon beer chicken, reach for the Ayesha Bakeware Nonstick Roaster with Convertible Rack, 11-inch x 15-inch and bring on the flavors, feasts, and fun.
